name: JDownloader-Discord-Monitor
description: Monitors one or more JDownloader instances via MyJDownloader and sends periodic, detailed Discord embeds showing active downloads, progress, and speed. Supports multiple devices, multilingual output (EN/DE), and fully automated status updates.

variables.name: Discord Webhook URL
variables.description: Discord webhook URL for sending status messages

variables.name: MyJDownloader Email
variables.description: Email address for your MyJDownloader account

variables.name: Devices
variables.description: Comma-separated list of JDownloader device names

variables.name: Update Interval (seconds)
variables.description: Interval between Discord updates in seconds

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Language setting: 'en' for English or 'de' for German
